schema: C1 (docs/CONTRACTS.md) plus documented extensions: {path,maxTier}, conditional, explicit ddt; see docs/POP-MODEL.md
damageTypesNote: Values = bloon properties the type can't damage, decoded from the game's immunity bitflags on bloonswiki. Fandom's older table differs: Glacier also blocked by Lead, Cold also by Frozen. 'Magic' is a tower class, not a BTD6 damage type (Wizards deal Energy). Glass is a Frontier Legends/boss property.
bloonImmunitiesNote: Camo is a targeting rule, not a damage immunity: only towers with detection can target or hurt it. Fortified only adds HP. Ice Monkeys also can't target bloons that are already frozen (Re-Freeze fixes that). BAD is immune to slows, stuns and knockback, not to damage.
